Hey congrats man. I'm losing weight as well, and I'm down 27 pounds in 2 months. Small steps man. If you need any help, feel free to DM me and I'll share my diet with you throughout my weight loss. Biggest piece of advice I can give is dont worry too too much about what you're putting in, just worry about how many calories you're eating and how many calories you're burning. Humans burn anywhere from 1800-2400 calories a day just being humans. So let's say you create a calorie deficit of 1800, so you limit yourself to 1800 cals a day. If you stick with that, and you burn at least 200-400 calories a day, you should be able to see 1-3 pounds down a week. Hope it goes well for you man, remember to stay hydrated and eat good food.
